headline: Attruby launch drives sharp revenue growth as losses narrow
summary_short: BridgeBio's Q1 2026 revenue rose to $195M, up 66.8% y/y and 26.2% q/q on Attruby's commercial ramp, while net loss narrowed slightly to $164M despite rising launch-related expenses.
summary_long: Revenue rose 66.8% y/y and 26.2% q/q to $195M, driven by a $143.9M increase in Attruby net product revenue and $9.3M higher royalty income, partially offset by the absence of a one-time $75M 2025 milestone. Operating expenses rose to $300.5M (+$79.5M y/y): SG&A +$57.5M on Attruby commercialization and pre-commercial launch prep, R&D +$15.2M on late-stage programs, cost of revenue +$7.3M on Attruby product costs. Net loss narrowed slightly to $164M; diluted EPS improved to -$0.84 from -$0.88. The board authorized a new $500M share buyback. Cash and equivalents were $880M at quarter-end per SEC filings (company reports $940M including short-term investments).
